svg.title: Best-before versus expiry dates in Canada
svg.desc: Side-by-side of CFIA best-before quality dates versus the short expiry-date list.
svg.text: Read the words on the package, not the panic
Canadian Food Inspection Agency consumer date-label pages. Love Food Hate Waste: date confusion is a large slice of avoidable waste.

g.text: Quality date on most short-life foods
Required when durable life is 90 days or less
Unopened + stored right: often still edible.
Opened food is a different clock.
Not a poison date. Use senses + storage.
Only a short CFIA list: infant formula,
Do not buy, sell, or eat after the date.
If unsure, read the printed words.

svg.text: Packaged-on + durable-life poster is the store-packed cousin. Raw meat slime or smell is a discard, not a date debate.
Saving Optimizer - Canada - 20 Sep 2026. Not medical advice. CFIA pages win over a TikTok.
